message: Good, but have everyone working together as a team in the final shot on the giant dust bunny, individual static shots of team members attacking it don't resolve great because they're all from the same static camera angle.
interpretation: Replace isolated frontal helper coverage with one coordinated shared team-cleaning shot in a three-quarter view and one gentle push-in; follow with full-company rainbow emergence. Existing solo candidates are preserved as unselected history, not approved.
